s2.heading: 2. What data we process
s2.answers_text: — answers to 15 questions, response time, final score and personality archetype. Without these the test cannot be evaluated or stored.
s2.details_text: — for each question the question ID, selected option (a, b, c, d), whether it was correct, reaction time, category and difficulty. Without these we cannot display a detailed answer review after the test completes.
s2.session_text: — generated automatically by Supabase. It does not contain your name, email or IP address. It is used to link your answers to your result.
s2.consent_text: — the version of the policy you approved, a timestamp and the categories you selected. Stored locally in your browser.
s2.trap_prefix: — a popup that prompts you to enter sensitive data (national ID number, card number, CVV, IBAN, password, OTP). This is purely an educational moment.
s2.trap_emph: The values you enter NEVER leave your browser
s2.trap_middle: — they are not sent to the server, not stored in the database, not written to
s2.trap_suffix: . They disappear from memory once the dialog is closed. We only store a single helper flag (`iiq_trap_seen`) so we don't show the popup again on your next visit — never any of your values.
s2.survey_prefix: — if you fill in the post-test survey: age group, gender, city, country, self-assessed caution (1–5), biggest online concern, whether you've ever fallen for a scam, where you heard about the test, whether you're interested in courses and which topics.
s2.survey_suffix: — you can submit an empty form too.
s2.anticheat_text: — question display time, redirects, attempt count. Processed solely to prevent abuse of the test.
s2.logs_text: — Cloudflare and Supabase retain IP addresses and request headers for a limited time (typically 7–30 days) for security and attack prevention. The controller does not access these logs during normal operation.
s2.exclusions_label: We do not request or process:
s2.exclusions_text: email, name, phone number, address, precise geolocation, payment card data, or any special categories of data under Art. 9 GDPR (health, faith, political opinions, etc.).

s4.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
s4.supabase_text: (USA, data stored in the EU Frankfurt region) — processor under Art. 28 GDPR; third-country transfer secured by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC).
s4.cloudflare_text: (USA, EU PoP) — processor for hosting and CDN, GDPR Data Processing Addendum + SCC.
s4.stripe_middle: (USA) — payment processor for voluntary support payments (card data collection, invoice issuance, recurring subscriptions). SCC transfer under Art. 46 GDPR. Activates only if you open the page
s4.resend_text: (USA) — processor for transactional emails (support confirmation, magic link for subscription management, refund warning). SCC transfer. No marketing emails.
s4.no_sell: We do not share data with advertising networks, data brokers or social networks. We do not sell data.
s4.share_text: if you click a "Share on Facebook / Messenger / WhatsApp / X / LinkedIn / Telegram" button, we open the official page of that platform directly with prefilled text and a link to the result. No code from those platforms (FB Pixel, X widget and the like) is loaded into our site — the share buttons are plain links. After the click you leave for that platform's server, at which point its own terms and privacy policy apply to you.
s4.utm_middle: ): when someone clicks a share link we generated, the URL contains information about which platform the visit came from. We
s4.utm_emph: only read these parameters if you have analytics consent enabled in the consent dialog
s4.utm_suffix: ; without consent the parameters are ignored and never sent anywhere. They serve solely for an aggregated "where do visitors come from" overview, not for profiling a specific person.

s5.heading: 5. Your rights
s5.intro: Under Art. 15–22 GDPR and § 21–28 zákona č. 18/2018 Z.z. you have the following rights vis-à-vis the controller:
s5.right_object_suffix: to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21)
s5.right_withdraw_suffix: without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal (Art. 7(3))
s5.right_complaint_suffix: with the Slovak Office for Personal Data Protection — Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava,
s5.deadline: We respond to requests within 30 days of receipt (Art. 12(3) GDPR). Free of charge, unless the request is manifestly unfounded or excessive.
s5.self_service_prefix: Since a test attempt is entirely anonymous and not tied to an email, the fastest way to erase your own result is to
s5.self_service_suffix: ) and click the "Delete this result" button at the bottom of the page. The row is immediately and physically deleted from the database and the share link ceases to exist. No email correspondence, no waiting.
s5.retention_prefix: A scheduled daily job runs at 03:00 UTC which (a) physically deletes attempts older than 36 months, (b) anonymises anti-cheat data on attempts older than 12 months, and (c) in edu mode anonymises the respondent's name + email after 12 months. The duration does not reset on activity — it is counted from the original creation of the attempt. These rules are written into the migrations (

s6.heading: 6. Automated decision-making and profiling
s6.p1_prefix: Test evaluation (score, percentile, archetype) is automated according to a fixed algorithm, but
s6.p1_emph: has no legal or similarly significant effect
s6.p1_suffix: on you within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR. It serves solely for entertainment and education. We only carry out profiling for marketing purposes with explicit consent (the "marketing" category in the cookie banner); no marketing profiling currently takes place.
s6.p2: Answer review on a share link is a read-only display of your stored answers — no new automated decision is created by it, no further profile or score arises.

s8.intro_emph: collect responses together with the respondent's name and email
s8.intro_middle: . Goal: the teacher wants to see how a specific student is improving. This mode is

s8.data_text: respondent name, email, score, answer detail (the same columns as in an anonymous test).
s8.access_text: the test author via a password-protected dashboard (password chosen by the author when creating the pack, hash stored via bcrypt). Our servers host the data; nobody accesses it outside the dashboard.

s8.callout_prefix: the primary contact for exercising your GDPR rights (Art. 15–22 — access, rectification, erasure, portability) is the

s8.callout_suffix: — we will help identify the author and forward your request.

s9.heading: 9. Security
s9.text: Communication uses HTTPS (TLS 1.3); data in Supabase is encrypted at-rest and in-transit; access to the database is protected by Row Level Security policies. Stripe-hosted card forms are PCI DSS Level 1 certified — our servers never see any card data. Passwords of edu pack authors are stored exclusively as bcrypt hashes (pgcrypto, cost factor 10) — we never store the original password anywhere.

s10.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
s10.text: On a material change to this policy we will show you a new cookie banner with a request for fresh consent (by bumping the record version). Minor language updates are published without notice. The current version always has its date next to the document title.

cookies.title: Cookies policy

s1.heading: 1. What cookies and similar technologies are
s1.prefix: By "cookies" in this policy we mean any storing of information on your device or access to it — including HTTP cookies,
s1.middle2: and IndexedDB. This scope is defined by the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC (Art. 5(3)), and in Slovak law by § 109 zákona č. 452/2021 Z.z. on electronic communications.

s2.heading: 2. Categories and legal bases
s2.intro: We split storage into four categories. Only categories 2.2–2.4 require consent. Category 2.1 operates on the basis of legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and your contractual requirement to take the test.

consent.purpose: Record of your consent (version + selected categories + timestamp)

supabase.purpose: Anonymous Supabase session — without it your test result cannot be saved via Row Level Security

locale.purpose: Your selected site language (sk / cs / en). Falls under the ePrivacy "strictly necessary" exemption — without it we couldn't render the page in the language you chose.

prefs.purpose: Remembering UI preferences between visits: sidebar open/closed state, whether you've seen the dashboard intro banner, whether you've dismissed the profile-completion nudge, whether you have the /blog pillar lists expanded. Without these cookies / localStorage entries every button still works — you just have to re-select on next visit. Language (`subenai.locale`) is always stored as strictly necessary so the page renders in the correct language.

analytics.purpose: Google Analytics 4 — anonymised traffic and interaction measurement, no personal identifiers

marketing.purpose: Personalised advertising, retargeting (not in use yet)

stripe_mid.purpose: Stripe machine ID — fraud prevention, device identification

stripe_sid.purpose: Stripe session ID — maintains the payment session

stripe_test.purpose: Stripe browser cookie support test (no personal data)

s3.future_emph: We currently do not integrate any advertising networks, social plugins or external analytics (e.g. Google Analytics).
s3.future_prefix: If we ever add an analytics or marketing tool (e.g. for traffic measurement, A/B tests or advertising campaigns), it will activate
s3.future_suffix: with your opt-in consent in the "analytics" or "marketing" category. When we add a new processor we will bump the version of this policy — the banner will reappear and we will ask for fresh consent.

s4.heading: 4. How to manage consent
s4.intro: You can change your selection at any time by clicking the button below or the "Cookie settings" link in the page footer. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

s5.heading: 5. Disabling via the browser
s5.suffix: directly in your browser settings. Without the necessary category, however, your test result will not be saved and the page will request consent again on every load.

s6.heading: 6. Changes to this policy
s6.prefix: On every material change we will bump
s6.suffix: and the banner will reappear so you can confirm the current version. Minor stylistic fixes do not require fresh consent.
